reviews.text:
Hello,
Do you currently sell hamsters (dwarf or Syrian)?

I would also like to know the price.

Thank you in advance for your reply 😊

Just so you know, unfortunately, they stopped selling animals in September. For those who want to adopt animals, it's best to go to another pet store. However, for those who would like to buy products for dogs, cats, and rodents, this pet store is perfect.
Excellent advice and a warm welcome.

Hello,

I would like to know the price for adopting a lop rabbit.

Thank you, have a good day.
Thank you for your trust. See you soon :)

Absolutely fantastic! A warm welcome and you can tell the owner is passionate. I decided to adopt a truly adorable little rabbit and thanks to his advice, it's going wonderfully. They have quality products and you can tell that animal welfare is a priority here!
Sold a pregnant hamster, 8 babies, and the only solution offered is euthanasia!
Thank you for your trust. See you soon ;)
Hello, thank you for your trust. See you soon :)

I had already come once before for information. The manager is really very friendly and gave me great advice. So I came back today to buy what I needed and I left with a gift for my kitten. That's really very kind of you, thank you again (the kitten thanks you too, he loves his little house!). I'll be coming here for my future purchases from now on!

Hi! Sorry to bother you, but what would the price be for a hamster?

I live quite far from Lyon and I can't really travel there just to ask the price. Thanks in advance! 😃 …

I'd like to know the price of goldfish, if possible.
I'm asking for people who have already bought goldfish.
It's a really great pet shop and the owners are lovely.
Thank you for your feedback and trust. See you soon :)
Thank you for your stars and your trust. See you soon :)
Great, but absolutely bring your own box for the hamsters; ours destroyed his in 5 seconds, we had to hold him down as best we could on the subway!
